model_provenance.purpose: Frozen-model conditional instruction invariance probe; no training.

selection: First three episodes in downloaded shard; frame 30 in each; fixed before inference.
goal_variants: next task cyclically among first three tasks

preprocessing.images: Rotate both cameras 180 degrees to raw LIBERO convention, then native CLIP transform.
preprocessing.state: EEF xyz; rotvec to Euler xyz; previous recorded gripper command (first action at episode start).
preprocessing.action: Recorded 7D action, no optimized or synthetic action.
preprocessing.gripper_mode: Native gripper_width=False; internally one-hot encodes recorded binary command.
preprocessing.compatibility_limit: Released eval shell sets gripper_width=True but its wrapper supplies 7D actions; native encoder requires 2 gripper dimensions in that mode. This experiment explicitly uses the implemented binary mode. It is not a released LIBERO evaluation reproduction.
preprocessing.data_limit: LeRobot conversion and state conventions are not byte-identical to author training data. Fixed across goal comparisons; no forecast-accuracy benchmark claim.
